description: 5 players play the Minority Game for exactly 12 rounds. You cannot speak to the other players. Each round, simultaneously choose 'go' or 'stay'. If fewer than half go, goers score 3 (minority wins). If half or more go, stayers score 3 (minority wins). You want to be in the minority! GOAL: Maximize your own score over the 12 rounds. The player with the highest score wins. Players: {agent_names}.

role_goals.Player: Maximize your own score over 12 rounds by being in the minority group. Top half of players by score win.
